Hannah / Karthik — see draft answers below that we can send to NovaCorp. I've kept the positions pragmatic to avoid blocking the deal while preserving our risk tolerances. I've attached a clean doc with proposed clause text (redwood_response_annex_v2.docx).

Summary (pick-one / preferred positions):

1) Liability cap (preferred): Cap equal to the greater of (a) twelve (12) months of paid subscription fees under the Order Form; or (b) USD 2,000,000.
   - Rationale: aligns to annual spend while providing a reasonable aggregate floor.
   - Alternate (conservative): fixed cap of USD 1,000,000 for initial pilot engagements only (can revisit after renewal).

2) IP allocation / outputs: Redwood policy is to grant customers a perpetual, non-exclusive, worldwide license to use and exploit their Customer Data and Customer-specific outputs generated by the Service. Redwood retains ownership of the platform, model weights, and improvements. We will not assign core model weights or platform IP.
   - Suggested language: "Customer owns Customer Data and Outputs. Redwood retains all rights in models, model weights, and platform improvements; customer is granted a perpetual, non-exclusive license to Outputs for its internal business purposes."

3) Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify for third-party claims alleging that the Service (as delivered) infringes a third party's intellectual property, subject to (i) Customer providing notice and cooperation, and (ii) exclusions for Customer-trained models that incorporate Customer-supplied third-party content. Liability for other claims limited to gross negligence and willful misconduct.

4) Compliance artifacts: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II attestation summary and our data residency commitments in a separate exhibit.

5) Order form mechanics: we recommend keeping the standard Order Form and attaching a one-page Annex with the cap formula and the indemnity bullets above. This keeps the main commercial terms clean and limits redline surface area.

Attachments (included): redwood_response_annex_v2.docx — contains draft clause text ready for insertion.

If you want, I can send this back to Lisa with the doc attached and offer a short call next week to walk them through the tradeoffs.
